reviews.comment: I absolutely loved Professor Burton! Very immersive and interesting class that I wish I could take again for the first time. Tom genuinely cares about all of his students, and his encouraging yet honest feedback on your interviews is indicative Very easy grading standards and a great class to prepare you for life after college.

Great professor! Professor Burton has lots of great professional experience, and he does a very good job teaching his skills and knowledge to his students. No exams, only mock interviews, which are graded very generously. Tom really cares for his students, and it shows in his teachings and grading!

Tom is the truly the best professor. You are graded weekly by photography assignments, a couple writing ones, and a final photo story. This class is super easy if you put in effort and ask questions. Cameras are provided, so if you are worried you will need one, don't fret. If you are looking for a great class and professor, take this one!!
This is the best prof at TAMU

Professor Burton is THE BEST professor I have ever had at TAMU. He is such a sweet guy and genuinely wants to help you learn and teach you about journalism. I recommend him for any course...20/10 professor.
*Was actually JOUR 484, Photojournalism. Amazing professor. This man is a GOOD teacher, and wants you to learn.

I love Prof. Burton!!! The exams are doable with in-class notes allowed (taken on Canvas), he's clear at communication and his lectures sound more conversational than just talking. There is one large group project so just do well on that. Overall, 11/10 professor, also keeps everyone updated on current events, as that's what Journalism is.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Incredibly simple class (with attendance not REALLY necessary but can sometimes score you a few points.) The lectures are really quite fun and helped me learn a lot! I worried that this class would be very test heavy or lecture heavy but everything is also posted online and you're allowed to use notes and his own slides during tests!

Professor Burton is an amazing teacher. This was my first semester at Texas A&M and he made it so enjoyable. The workload my seem like a lot, but the assignments are usually very easy. He is a generous grader and his critiques are very constructive. He is extremely easy to talk to and if you have questions or concerns just stop by office hours!
BEST class to take for GPA boost! No final exam. All other exams are open note. His lectures are very fun and entertaining! Attendance also isn't mandatory which was nice some days.

I love this professor! He makes the class as easy as possible while still making the lectures interesting and informative (literally had one over Lil Nas X). The exams are open book, open note, and open lecture slides. There are very few assignments outside of the exams and attendance, plus he gives great commentary under written assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is an amazing professor, and his lectures are very interesting. Attendance is required, but he makes you want to come to class. There are 5 exams, 1 essay, 1 group project, and attendance questions. His exams are open note/books, and aren't very difficult. He is a very easy grader, and if you have any questions he will respond quickly.

The BEST professor – I loved his class! He is kind and approachable yet professional. He clearly cares about his students AND his topics, and every part of the way the class is structured reflects that. He has interesting experience and knowledge to share. Assignments were simple, engaging, and valuable. I could not recommend this professor more!!!
He's so amazing, 10/10 would recommend taking any of his classes!

Even if you aren't a journalism major, you should 100% take this class. Tom gives great lectures on topics like conspiracies and movies. You literally don't even have to take notes because all of his exams are open-note and he lets you use his lecture slides. There is a group project towards the end of the semester. Take this class!

TAKE THIS CLASS. Not only the nicest professor in the world, but also a fairly easy class if you just show up. I never had to take notes just because he is so fun to listen to, and still got an A in the class. He is SO smart, but also just a fun guy to be around.
Very easy class. Attendance technically isn't mandatory. Fun class and interesting topics. Nice prof.

Easiest class you can take. Lectures were super interesting and I never took any notes because I was so absorbed in what he was talking about. Slide decks are uploaded online and by using those alone I got a 95+ on every exam (since they're open note).

I absolutely love this professor and class. I would recommend anyone to take him. He is actually very passionate about journalism and speaks from experience. He gives assignments that are actually very fun and does not grade difficult.

Tom is one of the best profs I've had at A&M! He is so kind, truly cares about his students, and is very passionate about journalism. It is impossible to not do well in this class. There are attendance points, but you rarely have to be there to do them and he gives multiple days until it's due. Exams are open note/ self explanatory. Take him!

He is genuinely the best professor I've had in my time at A&M. He is caring, kind and very understanding. He lectures on interesting material and is incredibly qualified so he gives unique perspectives. I never leave this class without a smile. Open note tests, little to no homework, overall a 10/10. TAKE THIS CLASS!

If I could choose one journalism professor whose heart is in it for the right reasons and truly cares about his students, it would be Tom Burton. I've had him for three classes and plan on taking more. I have gained more confidence in his class as he gives effective feedback. He is amazing, and you are really missing out if you don't take him.

Professor Burton is one of the best professors I've had at A&M. His lectures were entertaining and always contained something relevant to college students. Exams were on Canvas and straight from the slides. I slept through an exam once and he let me take it the next week. He also rounded my final grade up to an A when I was a couple points short.

Tom Burton is the best professor I've had at A&M. Cares more about the learning process rather than the grading process. If you show up and interact in his classes, they are all an easy A. His passion for journalism show during his lectures. He's also always down to have a conversation with students, whether it's journalism related or not :)

I originally registered for this class for credit but it quickly became my favorite class! Attendance isn't mandatory, but completing the attendance questions is mandatory to be counted present. Before each test, he allows us to write our own question and gives extra credit to the students whose questions he uses. Best of all, tests are open note!

Attendance isn't really mandatory, but I went to every lecture because he made it interesting and fun. There was a group project and writing assignments, but it wasn't hard and instructions were straight forward. Tests are open note and easy, I never got below an A! I highly recommend this professor and I can't wait to take other classes with him!

This class and Mr. Burton was so mazing. The things we learned about was so interesting and he makes it a class to learn and enjoy. The exams are essay and all open note and open slides. I didnt get lower than an A on any exam. The writing assiments are easy and interesting. The movies we watch are actually so good!!
My favorite Professor ever! He cares about his students and his lectures are interesting.

my jou 102 class only had 12 people in it, and it was awesome. Burton is super passionate about journalism and makes the class super easy. I feel that I learned a lot of applicable information without having to stress over it. Tests are open note, and there is a group project. I definitely hope to be in another one of his classes.
He is so sweet, attendance is mandatory but people often skipped and turned in attendance questions online. He really is passionate about his job and cares for his students

Prof Burton is THE BEST. His lectures are interesting and funny and I would take this class 10 times if i could. Tests are online in person but open note. Attendance is not mandatory, but his lectures make going to class worth it. He genuinley cares about his students and is very informative, knows what he's talking about! Very modern class topics.

Phenomenal professor. I highly recommend taking this class with him, he makes lectures fun and interesting. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he will sometimes do Canvas assignments for it. Only grades are attendance, exams, and one group project. Group project is sooooo easy, so this class should be an easy A and you learn a lot! :)
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor. He is engaging, and makes you want to go to class. He relates subject ideas to current events.

Prof Burton is a great professor, & cares for his students. All tests are open book, note, slides & taken on Canvas. He posts a required question on canvas for attendance. There is a team presentation near the end of the semester that is 25% of final grade. There are also a couple of written assignments, including the final. Class is easy & WORTH!

Professor Burton is awesome. This class is very easy, tests are all open note so you don't even have to go to class, but will want to because of his lectures. Very passionate and fascinating. Definitely recommend!

Prof Burton is the most interesting lecturer I have ever had at A&M and I am not even a journalism major. He is so helpful can caring and easily accessible inside and outside of class. Just take good notes on his lectures because the 4 exams are open notes. This class should be an easy A for you.
Need a statue of this man on campus!

His tests are open note and open slide shows and you are able to find everything in his slides that are needed for the exams. His attendance are posts on canvas that are open for hours and you are able to complete it out of class. Overall he's a great professor and I would take him again in a heart beat.

Everything that has been said about this professor is true. He is so pure and nice and his lectures were interesting. Open note tests, even if you don't take notes you should be fine bc he posts the slides anyways. If you can, I def recommend taking him!

Professor Burton is amazing! All of his notes get posted to canvas, so if you miss a class, it's not a big deal. The exams are open note and open book, so take really good notes and you will get A's on the exams. There is a group project at the end of the semester that is also very simple. He has such fun lectures and the class goes by super fast.

If you are looking for a social and behavioral sciences class this is the one. Attendance is optional as he posts all the notes online, and the tests are open note. His lectures are interesting and he loves to hold discussions about the topics. And if you are like me, you can use his class to catch up on some other homework if needed.

Professor Burton is a fantastic professor. He uses his knowledge from his past journalism experience in his lectures, which is very helpful when it comes to learning journalistic concepts. I wish I could retake this class.
This man was awesome

Professor Burton is one of my all-time favorite professors. The class was ridiculously easy- all open note exams, a few papers with very little word count. There are attendance questions posted after class but you can go through the lecture slides on your own and answer the question (usually there are easy opinion questions). Definitely Recommend.

This was my second class with Tom and he is my favorite prof I have taken at tamu. This course (mobile journalism) was super fun and part of the class was doing some form of weekly online post, so I was able to start a podcast. I am not a journalism major but even I learned so many cool things from this course and Tom is such an incredible prof.

Tom Burton is an amazing, caring professor. His lectures are so enjoyable, however are not mandatory to make an A. More often than not, I would just go to listen to his interesting material. Exams are very easy and open note. If you want a good basis of journalism that is an easy A, take Professor Burton!
Super easy class. Prof Burton is super nice and the class is interesting. No textbooks and exams are online and open notes/ slides.

You could get by in this class without going to any of his lectures, but I highly recommend you still go to them because he is so entertaining. The tests are easy As because they are open note, open book, open slides.

I had him for JOUR 304- editing for mass media and COMM 215- interview principles and practices (those weren't options). Nicest guy ever. Knows what he is talking about and simplifies it for you. Very patient and well-spoken. Take him if you get the chance- you won't regret it.

Professor Burton was great. He made class interesting, and brought a lot of his personal experience into his lectures. Even though I didn't have to go to class, I wanted to so I could hear what he had to say. He worked with me and my group when I was sick and had to miss our presentation of the final project.
His lectures are interesting, all the test are from the slides. He is a really caring guy. If you have problem on the grades you cam totally talk to him first.

TAKE HIM!! Professor Burton is an amazing professor with tons of field experience. His class was very easy, with open note exams (including being able to use his lecture slides for the exam). He genuinely cares about the well being of his students, and was very accesible outside of class.

Tom Burton's lectures were inspiring and informative. Although the class size was somewhat large if you wanted to connect with him he made it very easy to do so. Mr. Burton was able to use his real-world experience to teach about mass media in a commendable way. I will truly miss this class and his lectures.

TAKE PROF BURTON!!! Journalism 102 is an easy credit if you need one. All Exams are open note/ open book. There are four exams, 1 group project and 2 papers. Not hard at all to receive an A in his course. He is an amazing guy, his lectures are entertaining and the class is fun. You're crazy if you don't take him and this course.

I loved this course. Professor Burton is very hands-on and wants you to feel proud and accomplished of your work. Everything that I learned felt practical and relevant to the way the world now tells stories. I can only give so many compliments for the course. This is my favorite journalism course I've taken at A&M. I would take him for any class.
Professor Burton is an amazing professor. The exams are super easy and open notes, so there is no way to fail them. 4 exams, 1 group project, 2-3 writing assignments.

Professor Burton really makes this class what it is. He provides amazing feedback that will help you improve your abilities. Burton also cares about his students, he understands that things can be rough sometimes for students so he will do what he can to accommodate you. Lastly, I have taken him twice and both times he made the class enjoyable!
Prof Burton has real experience in the Journ field. He teaches from experience and you will learn a lot.  You wont want to miss class because his lectures are awesome.

Professor Burton is absolutely incredible. He's done so many cool things as a photojournalist and is a great teacher, which is rare. American Mass Media was a super interesting class and the movies we watched were captivating. His exams are open book/open note; you can even look at his lectures, so it's an easy A. Would 100% recommend taking him.

Tom is an amazing professor and he wants his students to succeed in journalism. Do the assignments and put in the little bit of work he asks and you will do just fine. He was very laid back this semester and is overall just a nice guy. Im going on my third course with him. Take him!

Mr. Burton is a fantastic lecturer who makes not always very interesting information fun and easy to understand! Take good notes on his lectures and watch the movies and you are practically guaranteed an A. Tests are open note, there is one group project, and one final essay. Highly recommend.

Highly recommend taking this professor. He made the class both fun and engaging and was extremely understanding with late work and extenuating circumstances. The exams are open-note and as long as you take notes from his slides, it's an easy A.

Professor Burton has been one of my favorite professors. His lectures always include interesting topics and stories from his experiences. The tests are open notes, so pay attention during the lectures and take good notes.

One of the most interesting classes I've taken. I was extremely impressed with Professor Burton's understanding of modern journalism and social media. He is very well informed and you will learn. The class is focused more on learning and less on grading so if you try at all you should get an A. Highly recommend.

I love this guy - gives great feedback on assignments and is a super easy grader. No textbook required and no tests, just one math quiz and a couple of assignments each week. He keeps it interesting and is just an all-around great prof!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Burton is amazing! I could tell he genuinely enjoyed teaching the material. The tests were open note/open book. He cares about his students and is willing to help if you ask!

Burton was an awesome professor! The class was a breeze for me, and it was mostly because he is such a great person. When Canvas crashed, he gave us extensions and was very understanding of our stress. He answered any questions we asked--no matter how random or stupid. Definitely recommend taking any class with him.

Professor Burton was definitely my favorite so far at A&M! He was super interesting in lecture. If you take some notes during lecture, you'll get an A on the test. I never got below a 97. Awesome dude. There is a group project but hes a really light grader. Final was a paper that I got a 100 on with minimal effort.

Prof. Burton was one of my favorite classes that I have taken at A&M ( American Mass Media). He is very kind and the lectures are extremely interesting and pretty applicable to real life. One group project worth 25% of the grade, though it is pretty easy and was very interesting seeing my classmates' work. Exams open note/book. Easy A if you work.

Professor Burton is my favorite professor at A&M. He cares so much about his students and always loves to connect with the class. He has very funny stories and is always in a great mood. If you show up to class and pay attention you should have no problem getting an A in the class.

Prof Burton is wonderful! Lectures are so interesting to listen to. Attendance quizzes that are more your opinion on things, some textbook reading, but most tests are generally from the lectures! A group project and a couple of writing assignments as well, but plenty of opportunities to make an A!

Professor Burtons class has easily been my favorite so far at A&M, his lectures are interesting and engaging, and I feel like I actually was able to enjoy learning instead of just trying to pass to get credit. I highly recommend him and his class.

Great professor! I really enjoyed his class. Each lecture was so interesting, I actually liked going to class. All tests are open note and open book, so I made an A+ on every test. There is one group project, but it is pretty easy. I liked his class so much, I'm taking him next semester. Definitely recommend����
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The first week, We had a test- and I was worried but ended up being a great class! Never gives busy work, very straight forward, doesnt try to trip up up on exams, like some profs. , Lectures are interesting, if you go to class and take good notes, youll do great! Super nice guy, definitely take him!

I LOVED this class. He lectures from powerpoints and posts them on ecampus after. He is really funny and super caring. Attendance isn't mandatory but most assignments are done in class. Take notes, some of his test questions are from lecture. Tests are open note and open book. I recommend renting textbook on amazon. Group project at end, no final!

His lectures are really cool and he's always sharing his experiences. Tests are open book and open note. It helps to study though so you don't waste time searching through everything. One big group project at the end. A really fun easy A class that's interesting. I loved this class and Tom!
